_comment: Patches applied to dev dependencies by cweagans/composer-patches.
This MUST stay a separate patches file rather than an `extra.patches` block in
composer.json. `extra` is copied verbatim into a consumer's composer.lock, and
the plugin's Dependencies resolver reads `extra.patches` out of that lock data for
every package in `packages`, so declaring patches inline would make THIS
package's dev patches leak into `uams-statamic` (which requires us in production)
and be applied against its vendor tree. Reading a dependency's patches FILE is an
unimplemented TODO in the resolver, so this form stays correctly root-only.
NodeVisitor::leaveNode() on a node whose enterNode() returned
DONT_TRAVERSE_CURRENT_AND_CHILDREN, so a `@pest-mutate-ignore` marker above a
statement did not suppress a mutator that targets the statement itself (wordpress-importer-archive#1401).
The patch remembers the marked node and skips it in leaveNode().
REMOVAL CRITERION: drop the patch (and, if it is the last one, this file,
patches.lock.json, and the cweagans/composer-patches dev dependency) once a
tagged pestphp/pest-plugin-mutate release on the 5.x line ships the fix. Tracked
